content:
**Secret Agent** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*. 

Increases the amount of time that Gulper slurry, Stealth Boys, Stealth Boy Mark IIIs, and Phantom Devices are active for.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Stealth Boys last four times as long! | 0038AB91 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Stealth Boys last three times as long! | 0038AB90 | 
| ★ | 1 | Stealth Boys last twice as long! | 0038AB8E |
